items.title: TCP Use-After-Free: CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
items.summary: CVE-2026-98432 is a critical use-after-free vulnerability in the Linux IPv4 TCP handshake, affecting kernels from 4.4 onward and allowing remote, unauthenticated attackers to achieve root code execution on servers with multipath TCP listeners. Fixed kernels are available for several stable branches, but Ubuntu and Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8, 9, and 10 remain vulnerable as of October 31, 2026.
items.why_it_matters: The vulnerability resides in kernel code executed during every IPv4 TCP connection acceptance before application visibility, enabling remote code execution without credentials on affected systems.
items.next_step_detail: Upgrade to kernel 6.6.159 or later (e.g., `sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade linux-image-$(uname -r)`).

items.title: We took over ChatGPT accounts: the MathLive postMessage chain, and the 20-line audit for your own listeners
items.summary: A complete ChatGPT account takeover was achieved via a MathLive postMessage listener that lacked sender checks, allowing an attacker to execute JavaScript as chatgpt.com and exfiltrate session tokens. The disclosure includes a 100-line static audit script that flags message listeners missing origin or source validation.
items.why_it_matters: The provided static audit allows developers to scan their codebases for message listeners that lack sender checks, identifying the specific vulnerability pattern that enabled the account takeover.
items.next_step_detail: Run `npm install mathlive@latest` (or the patched version) and add sender validation to all postMessage listeners as shown in the audit.

items.title: Do the math: How we took over ChatGPT accounts
items.summary: Researchers demonstrated that ChatGPT's share link feature could be abused to execute malicious JavaScript in a victim's authenticated session by bypassing the sandbox and Content Security Policy. The attack allowed access to private conversations and account takeover, which OpenAI fixed on October 26, 2026, classifying the issue as P1 severity.
items.why_it_matters: The vulnerability highlights that combining unrelated features like HTML Preview and interactive graphs can create unintended paths across security boundaries, allowing untrusted code to execute with full user privileges.
items.next_step_detail: Review the mitigation recommendations and audit your own ChatGPT integration code.

items.title: Orkas-AI / Orkas
items.summary: Orkas is an open-source, local-first desktop application for macOS and Windows that coordinates up to 16 specialist AI agents to execute multi-step projects. It features a Commander agent that plans tasks, assigns them to specific specialists like Claude Code or Codex, and uses auto-advance to continue work across sessions.
items.why_it_matters: It provides a local-first environment where agents can autonomously execute and review complex workflows, including code generation and content creation, without requiring external API keys for initial use.
items.next_step_detail: Download the free app, create a simple goal, and observe how the built‑in agents decompose it.
